audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows contradicted their own whys[] line — the sides gave Fiora levels 2, 3, first item and two items, while the prose says "You favour 2", "You keep 3", "Levels 4-5 stay yours", "You reclaim first-item" and "By 2+ items you hold the edge". The header was self-contradictory too: diff FAV with a red tone, an 8.5/10 difficulty and a report line reading "Hard matchup".
audit.why: The fiora__wukong mirror fixed this chart as win[1..3] to Wukong, win[4] to Fiora, win[5..6] to Wukong — identical to the packet chart and consistent with a 55.65% lane. Wukong's clone answers her whole gameplan; her one clean stage is 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped in BOTH layers as one matched group; tone, diffRating, breakdown.difficulty, report[2].t and report[14].t brought into line with FAV.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte is described as "parries + stuns your combo" without saying what triggers the stun, and the page's central plan is to land Cyclone's knockup.
audit.why: Riposte parries all incoming damage and only STUNS if it blocked an immobilizing effect — otherwise it just slows. So opening a fight with Cyclone's knockup into an available Riposte converts your ultimate into a stun on yourself, while opening with autos or the clone gets you a slow at worst. That conditional is the whole reason 'bait it first' is the advice, and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: The condition written into the cooldown block, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d and phases[3].why.
sources: champ-data/_kits/fiora.json (W: 'stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect')

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, despite 'trade around Riposte' appearing in nine separate fields.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16s — an enormous rank-1 window, and the single most encouraging number on the page for a Wukong who baits it with a clone. Lunge is 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s and Grand Challenge is 110/90/70s.
audit.corrected: 24s Riposte into phases[1].why, phases[2].why, phases[5].why, dosFull[0].d and the cooldown block; 13s Lunge into the cooldown block; 110s Grand Challenge into phases[4].why, spikes[1].text and the cooldown block.

audit.why: The packet flags "Grand Challenge's" in mid as a probable wrong name. It is the correct name in possessive form — a false positive.

notes: The header contradicted itself in four places at once: diff "FAV" with a red danger tone, difficulty 8.5/10, a "Hard matchup" rating line and a "His early" chart caption, all on a lane Wukong wins 55.65% and whose own whys[] hand him six of seven stages. Aligned everything to FAV. The mechanical addition worth the most: Riposte only stuns when it parries an immobilizing effect — so leading with Cyclone's knockup is what turns her parry into a stun on you, and leading with autos or the clone does not.
